# Arachne
Arachne have a humanoid upper body on top of a large spider's body. They bleed Copper Blood, like Arachnids, which can't be restored from Iron like normal blood.
## Spider body Their spider body means [color=#ffa500]no shoes[/color] can be worn, and jumpsuits and suits are fitted around the body. They are a little faster and a little lighter than a human.
## Silk and webs Like Arachnids, Arachne can spin silk when well fed, and can [color=yellow]lay a web[/color] on the tile they are standing on. They are not slowed down by spider webs.
## Other traits Arachne can click and chitter as emotes.
